page.overview:
Who is Brendas?

She is pale with cool, dark eyes, and a voice like chimes. She never shows any emotion and speaks in a level tone.

Brendas has a One Power strength level of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. This is strong enough to be able to Travel. She is the second strongest of the White Ajah among the Rebel Aes Sedai of which we have information, only Carlinya Sorevin being stronger and Bernaile Gelbarn her equal.

Brendas is 54 years old. She was born in and went to the Tower in . After twelve years as novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 985 NE.

She was an Accepted during the Aiel War. She and Temaile were on duty attending Tamra Ospenya, the Amyrlin Seat, and Gitara Moroso, her Keeper, before Moiraine and Siuan’s shift on the day Gitara has her Foretelling.
